craft_notes: Sthāyin: whirled (#2: v101's range, now the body — the fall IS the practice: agitation-powered-down INTO stillness). Sanskrit: paribhrāntaṃ paribhrāntaṃ...kampāśaktir nivṛttā paramāvasthā bhavati → L4 keeps doubled whirled line 1. Rows: row 3 (ceasing→born). Close: born (bhavati — supreme state BORN: the block's genesis-refrain with v60). Rejected: 'vibrations stop' — killed: agitation-power kept (kampā-śakti as the named force); 'falling down' — killed: fallen earth-ward kept (bhūmi as target, not floor).

lines: Whirled, whirled, body swiftly fallen earth-ward:
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhrāntvā bhrāntvā śarīreṇa tvaritam bhuvi pātanāt | kṣobhaśaktivirāmeṇa parā saṃjāyate daśā

reads_against.argmap: What state is born when agitation ceases? → Agitation's stopping is not collapse — the supreme state is born from it.
c1_essence: Whirling body ceasing agitation: supreme state born.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness reached through force of attention)
